payload.title: File:Parastylephorus anatoides (holotype, IUGM 100897 - colored).png
payload.artist_html: L. Ridolfi, A. E. Schrøder, A. Bahrami, M. Yazdi, A. Roa-Varón, G. Marramà, G. Carnevale
payload.credit_html: "A new fossil from the Eocene of Iran provides new insights regarding the evolution of the morphologically bizarre tube-eye fish"
payload.description_html: Skeletal anatomy of the holotype (IUGM 100897) of Parastylephorus anatoides: (1) neurocranium, infraorbital series, hyoid apparatus and branchial apparatus; (2) upper and lower jaws; (3) dorsal-fin rays and pterygiophores; (4) suspensorium bones and opercular series; (5) vertebral column; (6) pectoral girdle and fin; (7) lateral-line scales. Scale bar represents 10 mm.
